results.description:

The amount will carry interest at the State Bank of India marginal cost of funds-based lending rate (SBMCLR) plus 2% [...]HYDERABAD: The Telangana Real Estate Regulatory Authority (TG RERA) has directed Bhuvanteza Infra Projects Pvt Ltd to refund ₹14.1 lakh collected from a homebuyer for a flat in its Aura-2 project at Velimela in Sangareddy.

The amount will carry interest at the State Bank of India marginal cost of funds-based lending rate (SBMCLR) plus 2% a year, as reported by TOI.

TG RERA orders payment within 30 days

In its August 24 order, TG RERA directed the developer to make the payment within 30 days. It warned that non-compliance would invite action under Section 63 of the Real Estate (Regulation and Development) Act.

Lily Sahu, a resident of Odisha, had booked a 1,575 sq ft flat for ₹56.7 lakh under an agreement signed in June 2022. She paid ₹14 lakh to the developer.

Developer's managing director did not appear

Sahu alleged that the developer abandoned the project despite promising possession within 36 months. The company's managing director, Chekka Venkata Subramanyam, did not appear despite notices.

TG RERA proceeded ex parte and treated Sahu's evidence as uncontested.

The authority's records identify the matter as case no. 56/26, with Bhuvanteza Infra Projects Pvt Ltd represented by its managing director, Chekka Venkata Subramanyam.

results.title: Dollar moves in a narrow range ahead of inflation data, Jackson Hole
results.description: In Asian markets, the dollar held steady as traders looked ahead to crucial inflation reports, particularly the US PCE data set to be released before the Jackson Hole symposium this weekend. Meanwhile, oil prices dipped due to easing tensions in the Middle East and halted diplomatic negotiations. The Australian dollar strengthened following favorable inflation figures, while cryptocurrencies continued their upward trajectory, and gold saw a minor decline.

results.title: US shifts Iran war strategy from fresh strikes to sanctions as Trump seeks to squeeze Tehran: Report
results.description: The United States is implementing economic sanctions alongside a naval blockade aimed at Iran. These new measures specifically target cooperatives interacting with Tehran, striving to disrupt its funding sources. Recent military operations have dispelled maritime threats, reducing Iran's influence over global oil supplies, while oil ships are now navigating the Strait of Hormuz more frequently, signaling a push for renewed negotiations with Iran.
